vocabulary.definition: based on conjecture rather than knowledge
vocabulary.example: The theory about life originating from outer space is highly speculative.

vocabulary.definition: the complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism
vocabulary.example: Scientists are studying the human genome to understand genetic diseases better.

vocabulary.definition: a seemingly contradictory statement or situation that may reveal a hidden truth
vocabulary.example: The concept of time travel often presents a paradox where the past can be changed to alter the future.

vocabulary.definition: suitable or good enough to live in
vocabulary.example: Mars may not be habitable for humans without terraforming its environment.

vocabulary.definition: increasing or growing at a rapid and constantly accelerating rate

vocabulary.definition: relating to or inherited from an ancestor or ancestors
